name: BZX384B5V6-E3-08
title: BZX384 series: small-signal Zener diodes, 2.4 V to 75 V, 200 mW, in SOD-323
summary: Single silicon planar Zener diodes in the SOD-323 surface-mount package, rated 200 mW, with nominal voltages from 2.4 V to 75 V on the E24 steps. Each voltage comes as a C part (±5 % window) or a B part (±2 % window); E3 parts are commercial grade and HE3 parts are AEC-Q101 qualified. Zener voltage is measured with a pulsed current of 5 mA (2 mA from 27 V up). BZX384B5V6-E3-08 is the 5.6 V B part (5.49 V to 5.71 V), commercial grade, 3000 to a 7-inch reel.

operation.text: Nominal voltages follow the E24 series. The standard part has a C in its name and a ±5 % Zener voltage window; a B in the same place gives a ±2 % window. A B part and the C part of one voltage share their marking code, test currents, leakage and resistance limits; their temperature coefficient limits differ for some voltages.

VZ, ZZ and αVZ are given at IZT1: 5 mA for 2V4 to 24, 2 mA for 27 to 75. The knee resistance ZZK is given at IZT2: 1 mA for 2V4 to 24, 0.5 mA for 27 to 75. The Zener voltage is measured with a pulse current. From 15 V up, reverse leakage is specified at 0.7 times the nominal Zener voltage.

Ordering codes ending -E3 are RoHS-compliant commercial grade; codes ending -HE3 are RoHS-compliant and qualified to AEC-Q101. ESD capability to AEC-Q101 is above 8 kV human body model and above 800 V machine model.

The 200 mW rating holds for the diode on a fiberglass substrate at 25 °C ambient. The 650 K/W junction-to-ambient figure assumes the electrodes stay at ambient temperature. Fig. 2 gives the admissible dissipation against ambient temperature, reaching zero at 150 °C.
SOD-323 plastic body with two gull-wing leads, 4.3 mg, UL 94 V-0 molding compound, MSL 1, rated for soldering at 260 °C for 10 s at the terminals. A bar across the body marks the cathode end.
